title: 2026-11-05 research and engine defect probes: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on upstream NInfer a754fcf3 vs Strata v0.2.10 on RTX PRO 6000 (EXP-108, formal screen not entered, 31,000 and 40,960 MiB HostExperts CPU-expert-offload budgets refused at startup) and upstream #434 request starvation under context pressure reproduced on shipped source a87de361 across the native RTX 3090 C2 lane (440.94 s pause) and RTX 5090 production image (~398.8 s TTFT) with targeted fix candidate in draft alphastorm/ninfer#93 (EXP-109)
evidence_boundary: Maintainer-private raw harness logs and transcripts; public summary metrics are recorded here, while raw prompts, model outputs, credentials, and private host filesystem paths are excluded.
question: Does Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on upstream NInfer a754fcf3 clear omp-strata's preregistered rule-30 screen against Strata v0.2.10 on the RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell host (rtxpro6000-win-a) or start under an RTX 5090-class 31,000 MiB VRAM budget with CPU expert offload (HostExperts, EXP-108), and do upstream Neroued/ninfer#434 request starvation under context pressure and Neroued/ninfer#378 Host placement reproduce on the shipped v0.16.2 engine (a87de361) on the native RTX 3090 C2 (concurrency-2) lane (rtx3090-win-a) and the RTX 5090 C2 container image (rtx5090-win-a) (EXP-109)?
answer: EXP-108 (research only, not a product lane): on rtxpro6000-win-a (RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB, sm_120, WSL2), upstream NInfer a754fcf3 (binary sha256 prefix bcfba1b0, Flash-Next artifact rev 001057dd, 108,445,200,388 B) did not enter the formal rule-30 resident screen against stock Strata v0.2.10 (engine 0.1.56) + OMP 18.16.0 IQ3_S 262K because one W1 structured tool-call smoke emitted the tool call inside reasoning and ran to the length limit (a later 10x smoke-frequency probe passed 10/10 on both engines; the formal verdict stands). Exploratory M1-M6 numbers across the interleaved Strata A1 / NInfer / Strata A2 runs show faster C4 (concurrency-4) throughput and lower interference stall on NInfer (M1 short C4 aggregate 441.7 vs 264.2/270.8 tok/s, 1.63x; M2 64K C4 wall 23.82 vs 34.36/34.39 s, 1.44x; M5 stall 0.67 vs 3.83/3.84 s, 5.7x lower) but slower 200K cold tool-turn TTFT (M3 25.37 vs 22.32/22.43 s, 13.7% slower) and lower G24 verified passes/hour (M6 95.0 vs 115.6/118.9, 20.1% lower). Under NINFER_VRAM_BUDGET_MIB=31000 (and 40,960 MiB) on rtxpro6000-win-a forcing HostExperts (CPU expert offload) with ~155 GiB host RAM free, every configuration refused at startup. EXP-109: under the preregistered red condition (an admitted request with no token progress >= 120 s while others progress), upstream #434 starvation reproduced on both C2 (concurrency-2) lanes on shipped source a87de361: on rtx3090-win-a (v0.8.0-qwen38-3090-beta.2), a 79,989-token request paused 440.94 s after 62,464 input tokens with zero output/restores while the prime (first admitted long) request generated 16,150 tokens and 45 fresh requests completed; on rtx5090-win-a (image a0cbb8a5, 2 GiB scratch checkpoint store), an admitted 79,989-token request waited ~398.8 s for its first token while the other long request streamed and 48 fresh 247-token requests completed every ~10 s. Upstream #378 Host placement did not reproduce on the native RTX 3090 lane (4/5 Host-fill arms preserved the conversation at 99.995% peak Host occupancy while the oldest conversation was evicted instead); RTX 5090 #378 result: TODO: [LEAD WILL SUPPLY]. Draft alphastorm/ninfer#93 (e6ac7b70, 8/8 CI jobs green) ports the targeted fixes; GPU red/green on the rtxpro6000-win-a proxy: TODO: [LEAD WILL SUPPLY].

decision.action: Do not add a Qwen3.8-Flash-Next lane to omp-ninfer; keep Strata as the Flash-Next engine on the RTX PRO 6000 host (rtxpro6000-win-a) and hold draft alphastorm/ninfer#93 (head e6ac7b70) as the targeted engine fix candidate for a future runtime release without cutting a release in this research cycle
decision.rule: EXP-108 uses omp-strata's preregistered rule-30 screen (W1 structured tool-call smoke and G24 guard rails gating entry of the NInfer resident N arm into the M1-M6 comparison against bracketing Strata A1 and Strata A2 reference runs, plus RTX 5090-class 31,000 MiB VRAM budget startup feasibility for HostExperts CPU expert offload). EXP-109 preregisters starvation red as an admitted request making no token progress for >= 120 s while concurrent requests progress.
decision.verdict: EXP-108 formal verdict: NInfer resident (N) not entered (W1 tool-call smoke failure; exploratory M1-M6 recorded as non-gating diagnostics) and 31,000/40,960 MiB HostExperts startup refused. EXP-109 verdict: upstream #434 starvation REPRODUCED on both shipped C2 lanes (native RTX 3090 and RTX 5090 container); upstream #378 not reproduced on native RTX 3090 (RTX 5090 result: TODO: [LEAD WILL SUPPLY]); targeted fix candidate staged in draft alphastorm/ninfer#93 (e6ac7b70, 8/8 CI green; PRO proxy GPU red/green: TODO: [LEAD WILL SUPPLY]).
decision.reason: Upstream NInfer's Flash-Next offload planner refuses 31,000 MiB and 40,960 MiB device budgets at startup and requires ~63.3 GiB pinned host RAM for routed experts (above the 47 GiB physical RAM on rtx5090-win-a), while on the 96 GB RTX PRO 6000 host (rtxpro6000-win-a) NInfer failed the W1 entry smoke and trailed Strata by 20.1% on M6 G24 verified passes/hour. Separately, upstream #434 starvation is confirmed on the shipped v0.16.2 engine (a87de361) on both C2 lanes and has a targeted fix candidate staged in draft alphastorm/ninfer#93 rather than a 7-10 multi-agent-day full re-port to a754fcf3.
decision.not_decided_here: Promotion and full hardware qualification of draft alphastorm/ninfer#93 into a new omp-ninfer release (no release in this research cycle).
